metadata.title: NWI solo instrument clips: human-labeled 10-second clips of Chinese, Andean and Middle Eastern instruments with controls and Western cousins
metadata.description:
432 human-labeled 10-second solo clips of 12 instruments from three traditions (Chinese: erhu, pipa, dizi, guzheng; Andean: charango, quena, siku, bombo legüero; Middle Eastern: oud, ney, qanun, darbuka), two controls with their own AudioSet labels (sitar, tabla) and four Western cousins (violin, flute, acoustic guitar, snare drum), from Freesound and Wikimedia Commons. Built to measure AudioSet-trained audio models per instrument.

One labeler labeled every clip by ear in a blind queue; intra-rater self-agreement on a 10% relabel: Cohen's kappa 0.65 (n = 92). Includes labels for all 806 cut clips, uploader-disjoint train/test splits, a credit line for every clip, an AudioSet-style extension entry per instrument, a label guide and a datasheet.

Labels, metadata and splits: CC BY-NC 4.0. Each audio clip keeps its original license (CC0, public domain, CC BY, CC BY-NC); see LICENSE.md and credits.csv.
